info.title: Hearthroom Community API
info.description: Community browsing and member social features. Schemas describe the documented fields; responses may include additional fields.

get.description: Anonymous results exclude adult content. Authenticated visibility follows member settings. total may be null; use hasNext. Current policy is revalidated on cache hits. total may be null to avoid leaking filtered counts. Only verified visible results establish hasNext. Opaque cursors expire after one hour.

updateKind.description: minor is a silent content update. major explicitly requests notifications after the approved version becomes public.

updateNote.description: Public changelog. Required with major: at least 10 non-White_Space Unicode code points, at most 200 code points in the whole normalized text. Normalize CRLF/CR to LF and trim Unicode White_Space. minor accepts only an empty note.

400.description: Invalid update type or changelog; major requires a previously published card. review_length_insufficient returns detail.reviewLength: persona, constantWorldbook, total, required (3001), remaining, eligible, and informational welcome (excluded from total).

post.description: The optional policy/approval CAS pair must be supplied together and requires workVisibility enabled. New clients persist original operationId, intent and CAS. After unknown, read the original publication operation before retrying; never silently rebase. Legacy clients without CAS retain the existing protocol. Submission acceptance does not make a card public before approval. Updates default to silent. Explicit major intent and its changelog are part of operation identity; changing them requires a new operation after a definitive refusal. Notifications go once to the follower/favorite union only after publication, respecting notification settings. A work can publish a notification event once per 3 days; pending, rejected and withdrawn versions do not consume the interval. An unknown result must resume the same original intent. New submissions require a combined minimum of 3001 counted characters in roleDetailDesc and enabled constant Lorebook entry contents. Draft preflight and immutable revision validation use the same calculation. Completed operations replay without retrospective checks; existing public cards are not removed by this rule.

get.description: Returns up to 24 cards, filtered by your visibility and hidden-category settings. lang defaults to zh-Hant. Private bookmarks are retained as generic unavailable placeholders, without current private metadata. Only the owner can remove their bookmark. Reopening restores its original identity.

Your cards on the connected service, one page at a time, with their community listing state and this week's submission quota. `filter=all` and `filter=unlisted` read your cards from the service (`q` is matched there); `filter=listed` reads the cards you have listed on this site. `q` searches card names and descriptions, case-insensitively, with Traditional and Simplified Chinese matching each other; surrounding spaces are ignored and only the first 100 characters are used. `total` counts every card matching the filter and keyword, so `ceil(total / pageSize)` is the number of pages. Responses are private and never shared-cached; add `fresh=1` right after changing a card to skip this site's short cache of the service list. When workVisibility is enabled, items contain owner-only current metadata. listed/registered means submission history, not merely an existing link-sharing row.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Which cards: all of them, those listed on this site, or those not listed. `unlisted` is applied within the page read from the service.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keyword for card names and descriptions; Traditional and Simplified Chinese interchangeable. Empty = no keyword filter.

parameters.name: fresh
parameters.description: `1` skips this site's short cache of the service list.

parameters.name: X-Provider
parameters.description: Which connected service the bearer token belongs to.

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: Optional capability-gated access filter, applied before pagination to a bounded inventory of at most 200 sources. Disabled capability returns 409; over budget returns 503. Ordinary unfiltered inventory pagination has no 200-source limit.

First private/link sharing creates stable identity without a review, quota usage or reward. Restoring public requires unchanged approved content. Unknown results remain pending; read original operation before retrying. Same key and different intent conflicts.

post.summary: Delete an owned card and confirm any reward return
post.description: Persists the authenticated author's explicit recovery amount before contacting the service. An unknown reply keeps that original intent; read it with GET and retry with the same amount. Confirmed deletion is saved before local cleanup, and completion and listing withdrawal commit together. Rejections and unknown outcomes do not withdraw a still-existing card.

rewardRecoveryCredits.description: Actual amount read from the owner visibility projection and explicitly confirmed by the author; use zero without an active obligation.

200.description: Deletion confirmed, with any full reward recovery, and local listing withdrawn.

409.description: card_reward_recovery_required or card_reward_recovery_insufficient. No deletion or partial recovery occurs.

publicUntil.description: Exact end of the public retention obligation. Display in the reader's timezone.

publicDays.description: Saved retention duration of the award.

requiredCredits.description: Actual reward amount that must be recovered before author deletion.

availableCredits.description: Eligible unexpired and unreserved credits available at the failed recovery attempt.

shortfallCredits.description: Additional eligible credits needed for full recovery.

503.description: Authority unavailable or outcome unconfirmed; the local listing is preserved.

get.summary: Read an owned pending or completed deletion
get.description: Private, no-store read of this member's durable deletion consent. Read this before fetching a source that may already have been deleted. A rejected operation returns deletion:null; pending and confirmed operations retain their original amount for safe completion.

200.description: The member-owned deletion state or null.

200.description: Twenty visible published records per page, newest first. No drafts or private configuration data.

Timestamps labelled review are approval dates, not asserted exact publication instants; unknown is null, never created_at. target uses the same visibility checks and does not scan client-side pages.

memberToken.description: Current access token from an authorized Hearthroom sign-in. Cookie authentication alone is not accepted by these endpoints.

id.description: Public card ID. Use this for card detail, comments and favorites.

tips.description: Only included when reading a single card.

heat.description: Credits spent on this card by everyone except its author, summed across all published versions. Refreshed about hourly.

updateNote.description: Current approved-version changelog; empty for a silent version.

cover.description: Profile cover scene id; empty means the default scene.

score.description: The commenter's rating of this card; null when the commenter has not rated it.

kind.description: review_result, comment_reply, comment_like, followed_work, registration_pack, review_reminder or review_reminder_expired.

read_at.description: Unix milliseconds, or null when unread.

name.description: Display name, or the handle when none is set.

actor.description: Who did it, when the event has a person behind it.

name.description: Card name in the requested language.

extra.description: Kind-specific detail: review verdict (status), first review or update (kind: first or re), reviewer's note on a rejection (note), new work or update (event: new or update), like count (count), comment id (comment), listings granted (granted).

tipLinks.description: The author's tip page URLs, in canonical form.

cover.description: Profile cover scene id from the built-in catalog (shared/profile-covers.ts); empty means the default scene.

showStats.description: Whether the member's own profile shows works, chats, followers and following. Off by default.

count.description: Present for favorites; total favorites for the card.

roleId.description: Card id on the connected service.

detailId.description: Id for this site's card page (`/cards/{detailId}`).

workId.description: The work this card belongs to, when it has one.

sourceProvider.description: Service holding the work's original, when different.

visibility.description: Visibility on the service; empty for `filter=listed`.

registered.description: Whether the card is submitted to or listed on this site.

status.description: Review state on this site; only when registered.

updateStatus.description: Review state of a pending update to a listed card.

rating.description: The rating you declared; only when registered.

draftChanged.description: Present and true when the card is published but its draft has edits that have not been submitted for review: the draft's content version differs from the approved one. Edits to the Lorebook or presentation rules alone are not detected.

total.description: Cards matching the filter and keyword across all pages.

registeredTotal.description: How many of your cards are submitted to or listed on this site, overall.

id.description: Stable note identifier; also the anchor on the updates page.

liveAt.description: When the note first went live, in milliseconds.

announcedAt.description: When the note was last announced, in milliseconds.

title.description: One-sentence title in the requested language.

body.description: Optional one-sentence description; null in the summary view.

try.description: Site path where the change can be tried.

spotlight.description: Interface entry points marked as new.

seenThrough.description: Notes announced at or before this time count as seen.

stripClosedAt.description: When the home update hint was last closed or followed.

stripDays.description: Days the home update hint has shown without being used.

stripDay.description: Local date of the last counted day, as YYYY-MM-DD.

spotlights.description: Entry points the member has already used.

average.description: Average rating rounded to one decimal place; null when nobody has rated the card.

histogram.description: Number of ratings for 1 to 5 stars, in that order.

mine.description: The viewer's own rating; null for guests or when the viewer has not rated the card.

TipLink.description: An author's tip page on an external platform; the reader pays there.

nextMajorUpdateAt.description: Earliest next notified-update time (UTC ms), zero if no previous notified update. Private author readback.

publicUntil.description: Exact end of the saved public retention obligation; display in the reader's timezone.

days.description: Public retention duration saved with the original reward.

recoveryCredits.description: Actual credits to return for author deletion before publicUntil.

publishedAt.description: Actual publication time for new versions, legacy review time if available, otherwise null.

updateKind.description: Legacy versions without a recorded intent are minor.

updateNote.description: Frozen public changelog for a major revision, empty for minor.
